tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot reports sig:high_freq_sign_oscillation at the target horizon H = 0.6. Abstain without spending on another probe or submitting an unsupported forecast.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot reports high-frequency sign oscillation, so a fit to five endpoints would not justify a stationary forecast.
Finer sampling could characterize the oscillation, but the reported signature already meets the abstention criterion.
